milestone: N3-C public exact-commit lock generations and frozen/offline installation
implementation: Strict format-1 public kalandra.lock records exact manifest digest, root requests, unique sources, complete dependency edges, source digests and relative public entries
Pure bounded parsing validates aliases, identities, entry paths, duplicate/missing/unreachable nodes, cycles and path-height depth limits
Public lock is sole graph activation point; private installed.toml index is no longer produced or consumed
Normal installation validates retained source pins, stages a complete lock and rechecks captured inputs before atomic publication
Frozen requires a matching lock and may import missing exact snapshots without rewriting lock bytes; offline requires a matching lock/cache and never invokes Git
Offline compiler/checker/Metal source loading verifies captured lock roots, complete source records and snapshot integrity
Project output protection reserves lock/cache paths, hard/symbolic aliases, dangling links and prospective Metal output directories even without a managed cache

coverage: Deterministic generated lock output and fresh-cache reinstall from copied manifest/lock with private transitive versions
Frozen/offline preserve formatted lock bytes, inode and mtime; missing/stale lock and missing-cache offline attempts reject
Malformed formats/fields/identities/aliases, duplicate/missing/unreachable/cyclic graph nodes, escaping/Windows-drive entry paths and package/depth/byte budgets reject
Valid-looking forged digests, public entries and roots fail source/manifest verification without rewriting the lock
Concurrent creation/editing of the lock and manifest edits during installation preserve external edits and cancel activation
CPU and Metal project outputs cannot replace public lock/cache files via direct paths, hard links, symlinks or dangling aliases; Metal cannot create a directory at a missing reserved lock
Controlled HTTP/TLS frozen reinstall populates a fresh cache; missing-cache offline attempt sends no requests; cached installs/checks/builds work with servers stopped
Relocated installed CPU compiler consumes public locks and builds worker applications; numerical Metal imports qualify source emission only
Existing snapshot, scoped graph, project/library, overlay, sanitizer and installed-tool regressions
limitations: Exact commit declarations only; mutable-ref resolution, stable tag/branch pins and explicit update policy remain future work
Local repository identities retain declared absolute paths; remote sources do not store cache paths but universal OS/host compatibility is not qualified
Managed editor integration, authenticated/SSH transport and broader installed Metal execution remain pending
No new actual GPU execution qualification; no full native suite beyond selected 38 checks
No multi-file atomicity needed, but fsync/power-loss durability, crash cleanup, hostile filesystem races and cross-filesystem rename failure injection remain unqualified
